title: ConnectionsSetIntegrationMethodParams
description: Params for connections.setIntegrationMethod: the person's answer to the connect-time ask (ADR-0069) — a choice of integration method, not a yes/no about the helper. fingerprint is echoed verbatim from the open failure's helperConsentData (open.helperConsent.schema.json). When profileId names a saved connection, the method is written to that connection's desiredMode through the same write path profiles.patch uses; profileId absent (a hand-typed ssh with no saved connection) writes nothing here — the choice applies to that one open, carried instead on the open params' own desiredMode field. Choosing helper also records the machine's consent for fingerprint (ADR-0034); raw and script write nothing to the consent store.

fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the destination's host key, echoed from the open failure that raised the ask.

host.description: The destination, for the backend's log line only. The write is keyed by fingerprint (consent) and profileId (desiredMode), never by host.

profileId.description: The saved connection this answer belongs to. Absent for a hand-typed ssh with no saved profile.

method.description: The chosen integration method, drawn from the modes the product can carry today (ADR-0069) — never 'auto', which is not an answer.
